title: Sahih International opens the Quran with the name of God and a request for the straight path
summary: Sahih International renders Quran 1:1 as 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.'
body: The Sahih International translation of Quran 1:1 begins 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.' The same API response includes the Uthmani Arabic of that ayah. A translation is not the Arabic. The wording on the page includes: "In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
